desc: 落肩圆领短袖配磨毛贴布五分裤，霜瓷海报框呈现男童夏日两件套

name: 男童落肩圆领短袖磨毛贴布五分裤两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索与详情首屏一眼点击，用海报框承托整套穿搭并压住主卖点。
shots.textZone: one clay headline block in the upper poster border above the inset mat, plus two bare graphite hairline rails at the outer left edge

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则，把整套搭配的第一卖点用一块色卡说清。
shots.textZone: clay block at the right carries the promise, one empty graphite outline capsule under it

shots.intent: 用同机位双格对照把起皱塌形与平整有型的差别一眼比出来。
shots.textZone: one empty outline capsule at the lower edge of each panel

shots.intent: 承接参数焦虑，用一栏空白账表把规格信息位摆齐再由卖家填。
shots.textZone: one empty capsule under the section header unit on the right column

shots.intent: 用七列空表承托号型信息，把选码疑问留在图内解决。
shots.textZone: one empty capsule at the upper right of the table panel

shots.intent: 把整套放进真实的户外步道动线里，让家长代入夏日外出场景。
用领口与肩缝微距证明做工细节，替家长排除起球变形顾虑。
shots.textZone: one hairline leader to an empty capsule in the lower right mat band

shots.intent: 把膝部贴布与毛边工艺侧向拍清，撑起整套的设计溢价。
shots.textZone: one empty capsule on the defocused band at the upper right

shots.intent: 用lookbook卡片与造型道具补足搭配想象，抬高客单搭配可能。
全景平铺交代整套包含件数与搭配位，并留出可选配色空位。
shots.textZone: one empty capsule between the two blank colourway slot cards

shots.intent: 收口降风险，用背面挂拍与空白护理图标栏代替任何资质话术。
shots.textZone: one empty outline capsule above the six-cell rail

style.backgroundSystem: frost-porcelain blue poster field #D3DFE7 framing an inset paper mat #F2F6F8 that carries the photograph; seamless mat #F2F6F8 with pale cards #E3EAEF for packshot, spec, chart and flat-lay screens; one graphite hairline rectangle #2A2F36 offset outside the mat as a lookbook card edge; the architectural deck scene #5C6165 with a pebble channel #B7AE9E and a narrow still water edge #3E4A50 only on the two lifestyle screens; one flat clay block #C2703D may carry a headline, one block per screen
style.direction: cool porcelain poster-commerce for children's summer separates, editorial photo-frame logic with blank infographic rails
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline outline cells with clipped corners in graphite #2A2F36 on a porcelain field, empty by default and never numbered, no filled emblems, no seals, no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 6200-6400K key from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem, narrow angled light on texture screens, cool open shade on the deck screens, no harsh speculars and no warm golden cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool porcelain poster-commerce visual system for children's summer separates across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost-porcelain blue poster field #D3DFE7, porcelain paper mat #F2F6F8, graphite ink #2A2F36 and one clay accent #C2703D; daylight-balanced 6200-6400K lighting with an upper-left softbox key, bounce fill and true contact shadows; poster logic where a wide #D3DFE7 border frames an inset #F2F6F8 mat holding the photograph, plus one graphite hairline rectangle as an offset lookbook edge, and one architectural slate deck #5C6165 with a straight pebble channel #B7AE9E reserved for the two lifestyle screens only; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one bold display weight for headline blocks only; single-weight clipped-corner outline icon cells that stay empty; garments always presented as one matching set with stable scale, cropped below the neck or off-body; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the single clay block #C2703D
no mixed fonts, no serif, no brush lettering and no handwritten or retro lettering
no random backgrounds and no tropical resort or seaside scenery
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge, certification or test artwork
no adult or teen model proportions and no legible letters, numerals or year marks anywhere in frame
style.presentationRules: the short-sleeve top and the knee-length bottom always read as one set at identical scale across screens; the set is shown flat on a mat, hung on an invisible air form, or worn by a generic child model cropped below the neck, at the shoulders or from behind; silhouettes never clipped by a frame edge; the same slight 3/4 attitude repeats on hero, benefit and variant screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte porcelain paper #F2F6F8 and frost-blue board #D3DFE7 as the studio ground; large-format slate-grey porcelain deck tiles #5C6165 with hairline grout joints and one straight pebble-filled drainage channel #B7AE9E on the lifestyle screens only; surfaces stay clean, dry, unwrinkled and free of debris
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for all Chinese and Latin labels plus one bold display weight reserved for headline blocks; Chinese copy only as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; every rail, table cell, badge and icon slot stays blank unless a placeholder is named
